Messages.Author: carl.pi...@philips.com
Messages.Body:
In article <37B7E0...@wxs.nl>,


The question I let LSJ answer. :)
On the expansion issue, I can tell you the following:
WotC will bring out a 50+ cards expansion "Netrunner Classic" for tata:
Netrunner. :)
*If* it does well, we will see new VTES cards, but it's not sure how
many, or when. I guess, if the mini-expansion for NR does really well,
they will be inclined to do the same for VTES. So the baseline is:
people, spread the word about NR, 'cause we will profit if it sells
like hell. I will perhaps buy a few boosters NR myself, though I don't
play NR, I'd just do it to see if the artwork is cool, and to push my
favourite game (i.e. VTES). :)

Carl
